item.title: Goldsmiths’ Centre appoints Julia Balchin as interim director
item.description: Retail Jeweller Goldsmiths’ Centre appoints Julia Balchin as interim director The Goldsmiths’ Centre has announced the appointment of Julia Balchin as interim director, with the former Royal Drawing School principal set to take up the position in March 2026, succeeding outgoing director Peter Taylor MBE. Goldsmiths’ Centre appoints Julia Balchin as interim director Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Breitling named Official Watch Partner of Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team
item.description: Retail Jeweller Breitling named Official Watch Partner of Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team Swiss watch brand Breitling has announced a new global multi year partnership with Aston Martin and the Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team, becoming the team’s Official Watch Partner and marking the watch brand’s return to Formula 1. Breitling named Official Watch Partner of Aston Martin Aramco Formula One Team Ruth Faulkner

item.title: Three charged over Knightsbridge armed robbery
item.description: Retail Jeweller Three charged over Knightsbridge armed robbery Three men have been charged in connection with an armed robbery at a luxury store in Knightsbridge last month, during which high-value watches were reportedly stolen. Three charged over Knightsbridge armed robbery Ruth Faulkner

item.description: Retail Jeweller ROX launches permanent jewellery concession at Fairmont St Andrews Jeweller ROX has announced the launch of a new jewellery concession at Fairmont St Andrews, marking an expansion of its luxury retail presence through a partnership with the five-star Scottish resort. ROX launches permanent jewellery concession at Fairmont St Andrews Ruth Faulkner

item.description: Retail Jeweller KOUREE collaborates with Sharmadean Reid on limited-edition ‘Life Lessons’ charm Demi-fine jewellery brand KOUREE has partnered with entrepreneur and creative Sharmadean Reid on a new limited-edition charm designed to symbolise resilience, personal growth and transformation. item.title: Three men jailed for total of 51 years over £1.1m Richmond watch robbery
item.description: Retail Jeweller Three men jailed for total of 51 years over £1.1m Richmond watch robbery Three men have been jailed for a combined total of 51 years following a Metropolitan Police investigation into a £1.1m robbery at a luxury watch shop in Richmond in May 2024. item.title: UK footfall benefits from January sales boost
item.description: Retail Jeweller UK footfall benefits from January sales boost UK retail footfall rose in January as consumers who had held off from Christmas spending snapped up bargains in the sales, according to the latest data from BRC-KPMG. item.description: Retail Jeweller Sekonda expands cruise retail presence with Starboard Cruise Services partnership Sekonda Watches has announced a new partnership with Starboard Cruise Services, marking a further step in the brand’s expansion within the cruise retail sector. item.title: Namibia joins Luanda Accord as GJEPC and DMCC move toward Natural Diamond Council membership
item.description: Retail Jeweller Namibia joins Luanda Accord as GJEPC and DMCC move toward Natural Diamond Council membership The Republic of Namibia has become the latest government to sign the Luanda Accord, while India’s Gem and Jewellery Export Promotion Council (GJEPC) and the Dubai Multi Commodities Centre (DMCC) are set to move towards membership of the Natural Diamond Council (NDC). Namibia joins Luanda Accord as GJEPC and DMCC move toward Natural Diamond Council membership Ruth Faulkner
